beforeWhole.title: Planare chromatografische Trennungen durchführen und auswerten
beforeWhole.titleEn: Perform and interpret planar chromatographic separations
beforeWhole.description: Die lernende Person kann eine geeignete planare chromatografische Trennung durchführen, stationäre Phase und Laufmittel begründet auswählen, Startlinie, Laufmittelfront und eigene Rohdaten dokumentieren sowie Chromatogramme und Rf-Werte unter gleichen Methodenbedingungen mit Referenzen vergleichen, um Gemischbestandteile vorläufig zuzuordnen und die Grenzen dieser Zuordnung zu erläutern.
beforeWhole.descriptionEn: The learner can perform an appropriate planar chromatographic separation, justify the stationary phase and solvent, document the origin, solvent front and their own raw data, and compare chromatograms and Rf values with references under matched method conditions to provisionally assign mixture components and explain the limits of that assignment.

sourceRoleClarification.planarPerformance: Actual appropriate planar performance and its documented interpretation form this whole goal. Paper/TLC and substance domains are source-selected routes; they are not cumulative universal duties.
sourceRoleClarification.GCSeparateContribution: Carrier-gas principle and retention-time interpretation belong to the separately authored GC goal; no GC-instrument execution is demanded by either source correction.
sourceRoleClarification.HBPartialBoundary: HB p27 explanation and Rf interpretation are a partial contribution. They do not alone prove the additional canonical practical-performance claim.

authorRationale.oldProblem: Canonical solutions cluster53fd combines practical preparation with saturation calculation, independent concentration determination and reuse; it is not an atomic universal prerequisite and is omitted as a cluster by the decomposed HE scope.
authorRationale.actualNeed: Prior mixture/pure-substance distinction42a84 and safely preparing solutions from a provided working instruction135170 are the two concrete foundations. Appropriate phase/solvent interactions, own chromatographic execution, reference/blank comparisons and method-bound Rf reasoning are taught and assessed by978a itself. Do not introduce a new universal saturation-calculation duty by substituting413040 for the old cluster.
authorRationale.preserved: Entire DE/EN text, all three existing complete P cases and solutions/variations, actual-performance requirement, source variant boundaries and existing image unchanged. No experiment observed.

beforeWhole.title: Biodieselgewinnung durch Umesterung erklären
beforeWhole.description: Die lernende Person kann die Gewinnung von Biodiesel aus Pflanzenöl durch Umsetzung mit Methanol als Umesterung darstellen und Vor- und Nachteile des Einsatzes auf eine erklärte Stoff- und Systemgrenze beziehen.
beforeWhole.descriptionEn: The learner can represent biodiesel production from vegetable oil and methanol as transesterification and relate benefits and disadvantages to an explicit material/system boundary.

sourceCourseRoles.DE-HE: GK+LK for vegetable-oil child; LK only for biodiesel child, represented by explicit HE view override. Other source courses retain their actual separately stated roles; no universal LK claim.

authorRationale.oldProblem: Explaining the biodiesel process was made to require the stronger whole LK competence of independently planning transesterifications/equilibria. This hides an LK planning obligation inside some GK-source explanation routes.
authorRationale.actualNeed: Existing vegetable-oil/triglyceride structure plus ester formation, reversible ester reactions and the distinction between acidic/alkaline hydrolysis are the appropriate concrete prior concepts. The complete biodiesel P cases themselves teach the exchanged alcohol residue, 1:3:3:1 balance, free-acid/base interference and source-bounded sustainability.
authorRationale.preserved: Independent biodiesel explanation, all current DE/EN P cases, genuine national source/course differences and LK transesterification-planning goal remain unchanged; no actual synthesis or approval claimed.

beforeWhole.title: Unterenergiestufen aus Spektren und Ionisierungsenergien ableiten
beforeWhole.titleEn: Infer sub-energy levels from spectra and ionization energies
beforeWhole.description: Die lernende Person kann Emissionsspektren, Flammenfarben und erste Ionisierungsenergien ausgewählter Hauptgruppen-Atome als experimentelle Hinweise auf Unterenergiestufen deuten und daraus Haupt- und Nebenquantenzahl ableiten.
beforeWhole.descriptionEn: The learner can interpret emission spectra, flame colors, and first ionization energies of selected main-group atoms as experimental evidence for sub-energy levels and infer principal and angular-momentum quantum numbers.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Unterenergiestufen aus Spektren und Ionisierungsenergien ableiten
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Unterenergiestufen aus Spektren und Ionisierungsenergien ableiten.
resourceLinks.altText: Balken für erste Ionisierungsenergien: Be 900, B 801, N 1402 und O 1314 kJ/mol. Daneben ein qualitatives Energiemodell mit 1s bei n=1 sowie 2s und 2p bei n=2; s gehört zu ℓ=0, p zu ℓ=1. Ein schematischer Linien-Spektrumstreifen ist keinem Element zugeordnet.

authorRationale.oldProblem: The whole Sek-I atom/bond/geometry cluster is absent in the stage-only view and structurally demands17 disparate core leaves, including the broad memory node. This cannot be treated as a harmless display-only alias.
authorRationale.actualNeed: The two concrete existing predecessors f5ef(Energy-level model/electron distribution) and e9d(PSE structural interpretation) were already directly required and remain, as does orientation. The whole current P profile supplies orbital configurations and teaches sublevel, pairing and spectral inferences; ionic lattices, metal bonding, molecular geometry and full unrelated recall are not universal prior duties.
authorRationale.preserved: Every DE/EN word, whole two-case P design, real numeric exceptions and image unchanged. Only the overbroad cluster edge is removed; both existing meaningful atomic prerequisites remain.
